summary: Tested Martian AI Pricing Control Center feature. All 8 backend API tests passed. Frontend verified: Admin Custom Packages tab shows 3 sections (Agent Pricing, Credit Presets, Extra Credit Packs), profit margin badges calculated from real avg cost ($0.0181), Save All Pricing button saves both configs. Pricing page displays credit packages from API.
passed_tests: GET /api/admin/credit-packages returns list of extra credit packs with id, credits, price_usd, price_bdt, name
POST /api/admin/credit-packages saves updated packages to DB
GET /api/plans returns credit_packages from DB (not hardcoded)
GET /api/plans returns custom_package config with credit_presets
GET /api/admin/custom-package returns agent/commander pricing + credit presets
GET /api/admin/avg-cost returns avg cost per credit from real usage
Admin credit packages sync correctly to /api/plans endpoint
Admin Custom Packages tab shows 3 sections: Agent & Commander Pricing, Credit Presets, Extra Credit Packs
Each credit row shows profit margin badge calculated from real avg cost ($0.0181/credit)
Save All Pricing button saves both custom-package and credit-packages configs (toast 'All pricing saved!' appears)
Pricing page (/pricing) shows credit packages from API in 'Need More Credits?' section
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/admin/credit-packages correctly returns packages with id, credits, price_usd, price_bdt, name fields
POST /api/admin/credit-packages properly validates and saves packages to platform_config collection
GET /api/plans correctly returns credit_packages from DB via get_credit_packages() helper
Profit margin calculation using profitBadge() function: margin = (price - cost)/cost * 100 where cost = credits * avgCost
handleSave() in CustomPackagesTab correctly calls both POST endpoints in parallel
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pricing Control Center is fully working. Admin can set prices for: (1) Agent & Commander per-unit pricing in Build Your Own section, (2) Credit Presets for Build Your Own packages, (3) Extra Credit Packs shown in 'Need More Credits?' section on Pricing page. All prices stored in platform_config collection with config_type='credit_packages' for extra packs and config_type='custom_packages' for agent pricing + credit presets. Profit margins auto-calculated from real API cost stored in avg_cost endpoint.
